rites.name: Amereornium
rites.text: Amereornium is the concept of the Martial Realm in Khairnar, the thread by which the first roots of the world were drawn tight during the Singing. In the Holy Age its temples kept flame and discipline, and its orders taught that power is measured by what one can hold without breaking.

rites.name: Brornede
rites.text: Brornede is a concept held in the Courts of Khairnar, an idea of a bound oath that the council of the first sovereign used to test divine trials. It is recorded as a principle that shaped the doors between worlds during the grove-kingdom era.

rites.name: Valentilum
rites.text: Valentilum is the concept of the bond held between a sworn blade and the ground it defends, as taught in the Khairnar Martial Realm during the Fall and the Sundering. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall shattered old oaths, Valentilum was the discipline that let warriors hold their pact even as the shards drifted apart.
